overview: Cloud-hosted legacy enterprise documentation platform with proprietary formatting and closed AI lock-in.
keyStrengths: Established enterprise brand with deep procurement relationships
Extensive out-of-the-box WYSIWYG rich text editor for non-technical users
keyWeaknesses: Proprietary cloud silo; markdown files cannot be checked into Git repositories
No native integration with modern AI coding environments (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code)
Expensive per-seat pricing with aggressive annual enterprise lock-in contracts
Slow search indexing and frequent stale content without automated schema audits
ourSilverBullets: Native Git repository integration: documentation lives directly next to code with instant version control and diffing.
Open Source and AI decoupled: works seamlessly across Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf via standard SSOT adapters.
Deterministic schema validation: built-in CLI checks that prevent knowledge decay.

pricingComparison.discountPractices: Aggressive end-of-quarter 30-40% discounts for 3-year upfront contracts

commonObjections.objection: Alpha Corp is already approved by our central procurement team.
commonObjections.responseScript: While Alpha Corp is great for general company wikis, your developers and AI copilots need instant, repo-level grounding. We operate alongside your existing wiki or can replace developer docs with zero per-seat tax.

commonWinReasons: No vendor lock-in with open Markdown
commonLossReasons: Strict company-wide mandate to use pre-contracted enterprise vendor
Lack of non-technical WYSIWYG editing for marketing-only teams
